titre: Getting my child's ID card or passport
resume: The exact documents to bring to the town hall (mairie) for your situation (first application, renewal, loss, separated parents, shared residence), the fees that apply in Mayotte and the rules on the child being present.
aQuoiCaSert: The ID card and the passport prove your child's identity and French nationality and allow them to travel. A minor can have one at any age. You apply at a town hall equipped with a registration station, not necessarily the one in your own town. An application turned down because a document is missing is the most common reason for a wasted trip: prepare the list that matches your situation.
quiEstConcerne: The parent (or guardian) who holds parental authority: they submit the application, together with the child.
Separated parents, parents with shared residence, or families where only one parent holds parental authority: additional documents are required.
A legal representative who is not a parent (guardian, aide sociale à l'enfance, the child welfare service): they must prove their delegation of parental authority.
aSavoir: ID card: free for a first application, and for a renewal if you present the old card. If it was lost or stolen, a €25 tax stamp (timbre fiscal). Valid for 10 years.

Passport in Mayotte: national fees, €17 for a child under 15, €42 from 15 to 17 if you provide the photo (€20 and €45 if the photo is taken at the counter). The reduced fees of French Guiana do not apply in Mayotte. Valid for 5 years.
The child and the parent must come together to submit the application. Fingerprints are taken from age 12.
Collection: under 12, the parent comes alone; from age 12, the child must be present. The document must be collected within 3 months, otherwise it is destroyed.
Separated parents with shared residence: both addresses can appear on the document if you bring proof of the shared residence and a proof of address for each parent.
Only one parent holds parental authority: bring the document that proves it (for example the judgment).

Birth certificate: only requested if the child has no document that is valid or expired less than 5 years ago, and if the civil registry of their town of birth is not digitized. It must be less than 3 months old.

documents.libelle: An ID photo less than 6 months old that meets the standards
documents.detail: Original. For a passport, a photo you provide costs less than one taken at the counter.

documents.libelle: Valid ID of the parent submitting the application
documents.detail: Original. This parent must hold parental authority and come with the child.

documents.libelle: Proof of address in the name of the parent submitting the application
documents.detail: Original, recent (utility bill, tax notice, rent receipt).

documents.libelle: The child's old ID card and passport, if they have any
documents.detail: Originals, even if expired less than 5 years ago.

documents.libelle: The child's birth certificate, less than 3 months old, if requested
documents.detail: Free, from the town hall of the place of birth.

documents.libelle: Proof of French nationality, if it is not shown on the birth certificate
documents.detail: For example a certificate of French nationality: the town hall will tell you which document fits.

documents.libelle: Judgment or agreement setting parental authority or the child's residence
documents.detail: Copy. Required if only one parent holds parental authority, or to have both addresses shown in shared residence.

documents.libelle: Proof of address of the other parent (shared residence)
documents.detail: Only if you want both addresses on the document.

documents.libelle: Declaration of loss (cerfa n° 14011) or receipt for a theft report
documents.detail: For a theft, report it first to the police or gendarmerie.
Passport, or lost or stolen ID card. Buy it online (timbres.impots.gouv.fr) or at an authorized tobacco shop (bureau de tabac).

documents.libelle: ANTS pre-application number or QR code
documents.detail: Optional, but it saves time at the counter.

etapes.detail: First application, renewal, loss or theft, then your family situation. The list of documents depends on it.

etapes.titre: Complete the online pre-application on the ANTS website
etapes.detail: Optional. The ANTS (Agence nationale des titres sécurisés) is the national agency for secure documents. Buy the tax stamp if needed.

etapes.titre: Book an appointment at an equipped town hall
etapes.detail: Appointments may be far off: plan ahead before a trip.

Originals only. Photo less than 6 months old, your valid ID, proof of address, the child's old document, tax stamp if needed, judgment or agreement if you are separated, birth certificate if requested. The child comes with you.

etapes.titre: Submit the application with your child

etapes.detail: From age 12, the child must be present. Then store a copy in the Vault.
